candidate_search_budget: ONE new from-scratch selective-fusion depth run, 20epochs seed20261101 candidates5/10/20. No other seeds, selector widths, fusion scales, loss or epoch sweeps. Reuse existing scalar-depth and V3 RGB comparisons without retraining.
selection_policy: Diagnostic-only evaluation of all three candidates first. A separately recorded diagnostic acceptance is required before selection. Formal selection uses all three candidates, artifact screen first, mean native PSNR; ties within 0.01 dB use SSIM then earlier step. No final-test/challenging access.
review_rubric: Zero major artifacts and at most four minor cases of 40; same original rubric and two independent review records. No aggregate score overrides artifact failure.
diagnostic_continuation: Compare all three candidates against matched scalar-depth and V3 RGB checkpoints on diagnostic40. At least one must match or exceed BOTH matched RGB means and not regress either matched scalar-depth mean. Fixed8 native review must find no new major defect. On fixed3 final-checkpoint probes, assess zero-input, flipped-depth and actual fusion removal; do not infer a universal repair. Failure closes this setting without automatic sweep. Selection requires recorded acceptance; final sets sealed.
rationale: Fixed3 diagnostics show useful depth dependence on fish/wreck but harmful fusion on equipment with correct cache. Add RGB/depth-conditioned per-location per-channel suppression rather than blanket fusion removal. Hypothesis, not calibrated confidence.
